description: Read the timeline of one of this user’s Social lists. Call it without list_id first to see the available lists and their ids.

list_id.description: The list to read; omit to list the available lists instead

max_id.description: Page back: the next-page cursor a previous call returned, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

min_id.description: Page forward: only entries newer than this cursor, as a string of digits exactly as Social returned it

name: social_list_timeline
title: Read Social List Timeline
